svg.title: Figure 1. The three parts of Lab 2
svg.desc: Three schematics. (a) A flat aluminum bar held in wedge grips and pulled by a load P, with an axial and a transverse strain gage on the front face and the same pair on the back face. (b) A steel rod inside an aluminum tube between two rigid caps on a press; the tube is slightly shorter, leaving a small gap under the top cap, drawn exaggerated. Gages are on the tube and a dial gage measures the caps' approach. (c) A steel bolt with head and nut clamping an aluminum sleeve, submerged in a water bath heated from 20 to 80 degrees Celsius, with a strain gage on the bolt shank and a thermocouple in the water.
